basis: Original Fry 300 words plus lowercase short headwords from the installed Webster dictionary and familiar scene vocabulary. This is an offline vocabulary expansion, not a frequency ranking. It is only a secondary exemption; absence never makes a lowercase word private. Identity, digit and phrase rules take priority.

offlineSource.selection: lowercase alphabetic headwords of 2 to 5 letters, excluding the installed propernames list; original words and familiar scene words retained
